# netbox_available_asn (Resource)

Allocates the next available ASN in an ASN range (`POST /api/ipam/asn-ranges/{id}/available-asns/`) and manages the resulting ASN (`/api/ipam/asns/`). The RIR is inherited from the range. Changing `asn_range_id` allocates a new ASN.

After `terraform import` the range is unknown, so `asn_range_id` stays null in state; setting it in the configuration of an imported resource forces a replacement.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Hand-maintained example for netbox_available_asn.

resource "netbox_rir" "private" {
  name       = "RFC 6996"
  slug       = "rfc6996"
  is_private = true
}

resource "netbox_asn_range" "private_32bit" {
  name   = "Private 32-bit ASNs"
  slug   = "private-32bit"
  rir_id = netbox_rir.private.id
  start  = 4200000000
  end    = 4200000999
}

resource "netbox_tenant" "acme" {
  name = "ACME"
  slug = "acme"
}

# Take the next free AS number from the range.
resource "netbox_available_asn" "acme_edge" {
  asn_range_id = netbox_asn_range.private_32bit.id
  tenant_id    = netbox_tenant.acme.id
  description  = "ACME edge routers"
}

output "acme_edge_asn" {
  value = netbox_available_asn.acme_edge.asn # e.g. 4200000000
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `asn_range_id` (Number) ID of the ASN range (`netbox_asn_range`) to allocate from.

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Comments.
- `custom_fields` (String) Custom field values as a JSON object (`jsonencode({...})`). Only keys present in the configuration are tracked.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to this object. Defaults to no tags when omitted.
- `tenant_id` (Number) ID of the Tenant (`netbox_tenant`).

### Read-Only

- `asn` (Number) The allocated 16- or 32-bit autonomous system number.
- `display` (String) Display name of the object.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the ASN object in NetBox (not the AS number itself).
- `rir_id` (Number) ID of the RIR (`netbox_rir`), inherited from the ASN range.
- `url` (String) URL of the object in the NetBox API.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# netbox_available_asn is imported by the ID of the allocated ASN object (the
# number in the object's URL, not the AS number). asn_range_id cannot be
# recovered and stays null; omit it from the configuration of imported resources.
terraform import netbox_available_asn.acme_edge 123
```
